svg.title: AI Automation for SEO
svg.desc: Animated workflow showing how Enablly's forward-deployed AI automation handles SEO: a website and target keywords arrive, a crawl agent sorts technical, content and link issues, AI research analyses search intent with Google Gemini and Perplexity, AI production drafts briefs, meta tags, internal links and schema with OpenAI and Claude, an SEO lead approves the briefs, and optimised pages, a brief queue, and AI-search citation tracking are delivered.
